It contains (nonce, sourceDomain) which is guaranteed by CCTP to be unique. * offchainTokenData is untrusted (can be supplied by manual execution), but we assert that (nonce, sourceDomain) is equal to the message's (nonce, sourceDomain) and receiveMessage will assert that Attestation contains a valid attestation signature for that message, including its (nonce, sourceDomain). This way, the only non-reverting offchainTokenData that can be supplied is a valid attestation for the specific message that was sent on source.
